name: Mission Mile Run Club
tagline: Conference-morning social runs for 40 to 80, with coffee after and shirts in your colors.
bio: I'm Dani. We run an easy 5K with two pace groups and a walking group, then coffee. Conference weeks are our busiest: a morning run is the side event people actually remember.
terms: Free to cancel up to 7 days before.
backupPlan: Four pacers; rain moves us to a covered route.

experiences.name: Conference-morning social run
experiences.desc: An easy 5K from Moscone, two paces and a walking group, coffee and pastries after. Back by 8:30 for the keynote.
experiences.allIn: Pacers, permit, coffee, pastries and tax. Shirts $25 each.
experiences.access: Walking group for anyone who'd rather not run.
experiences.setup: Meet at a hotel lobby or Yerba Buena Gardens.
experiences.branding: Shirts or hats in your colors. Needs 2 weeks.
